monitored_text: Home Newsroom JLCCNC Participates in Hannover Messe 2025 JLCCNC Participates in Hannover Messe 2025 Press Release Mar 10, 2025 JLCCNC will exhibit at Hannover Messe from 31 March to 4 April 2025 at Hannover Messe in Germany. With the theme of ‘Energising A Sustainable Industry’, JLC Global will be showcasing its full range of technologies in 3D printing, CNC machining, Mechanical Components, PCB, PCBA and PCB design software development in Hall 17, Booth B12, demonstrating its expertise in smart manufacturing and digital transformation. It demonstrates its leading strength in the field of intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation. Exhibition Information · Event Theme : Hannover Messe 2025 - "Energizing A Sustainable Industry" · Dates : March 31 to April 4, 2025 · Location : Hannover Exhibition Center, 30521 Hannover, Germany · JLCCNC Booth : Hall 17, Stand B12 (together with JLCPCB) · Exhibits : 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Mechanical Components , PCB, PCBA, PCB Design Software Development 1. Exhibition Background As one of the world's largest and most influential industrial events, Hannover Messe has always been the wind vane for global industrial automation, digital manufacturing and sustainable industrial development. With the theme of ‘Energising A Sustainable Industry’, this year's fair focuses on green energy, intelligent manufacturing and sustainable development, and attracts many global leading enterprises and experts to gather and discuss the new trends of future industry. 2. About JLC Global JLC Global is a comprehensive technology company dedicated to promoting industrial intelligence and digital transformation. The company focuses on the R&D and production of 3D printing, CNC machining, automated production, and the whole industry chain of electronic manufacturing such as PCB and PCBA. Relying on strong technological strength and innovative R&D capabilities, JLC Global continues to provide efficient and accurate manufacturing solutions for global customers and leads the industry with continuous technological innovation. In recent years, JLC Global has made remarkable achievements in the field of intelligent manufacturing and green production, and has successfully implemented a number of major projects to create a sustainable and efficient production system for its customers. 3. Exhibition Highlights and Product/Technology Details In this Hannover Messe, JLC Global will comprehensively display the core technologies and innovative products of its entire business line, specifically including: CNC Machining : The company will display advanced CNC machining systems to ensure efficient and accurate parts machining capability. 3D Printing : Showcasing high-precision, rapid prototyping 3D printing technology to meet diversified industrial manufacturing needs. Mechanical Components : JLC Mechatronic Components Marketplace integrates various mechatronic parts, aiming to provide a one-stop service for factory automation. PCB & PCBA : Showcasing the whole industry chain services from PCB design, manufacturing to assembly, helping the rapid iteration of electronic products. PCB Design Software Development : Introducing self-developed PCB design software to enhance design efficiency and product innovation. At the exhibition site, visitors will have the opportunity to fully understand JLC Global's innovations in process, technology and products, and deeply experience the company's all-round solutions in the field of intelligent manufacturing through interactive experience. 4. More Information For more exhibition activities and the latest news of JLCCNC, please visit our official website and follow our official social media platforms. We will be arranging on-site experts to answer questions and provide technical demonstrations, and we sincerely invite all professionals to come and exchange views, and witness the future changes of industrial technology together. If you have CNC machining needs, click to get a free quote for our cnc machining services.
